events.title: KRENDEL Demo is OUT NOW!
events.summary: After a long wait, the KRENDEL demo is finally here!Step into a strange world where curiosity gets you into trouble, and the world itself becomes one big puzzle.KRENDEL is a wordless point-and-click adventure filled with quirky characters, absurd situations, and a little bit of mystery.The demo takes around 15 minutes to complete.If you’ve been following KRENDEL — thank you for waiting. ❤️And if this is your first time seeing the game, welcome!🎮 Play the free demo and add KRENDEL to your wishlis
